name.ja: ＭＧ 1/100 ジェスタ・キャノン

description.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム UC（ユニコーン）』から、大型火器を備えた重装備ＭＳ ジェスタ・キャノンが登場！！
description.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam UC (Unicorn)" comes the Jesta Cannon, a heavily armed MS equipped with a large firearm! !

description.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダムＵＣ episode6』『機動戦士ガンダムＵＣ episode7』に登場する、火器管制能力が強化された重装仕様タイプのジェスタ・キャノンが１/１００スケールマスターグレードシリーズで商品化。
description.en: The Jesta Cannon, a heavily armed type with enhanced fire control ability that appears in "Mobile Suit Gundam UC episode 6 " and " Mobile Suit Gundam UC episode 7", has been commercialized in the 1/100 Scale Master Grade Series.

description.ja: 重装化にともなう、特徴的な武装や増加装甲を施された各部位を、新規造形で再現！
description.en: Each part that has been given distinctive armament and increased armor due to heavy armoring has been reproduced with new modeling!

description.ja: ●　ビーム・キャノンなどの追加武装を徹底再現！
description.en: ● Thorough reproduction of additional weapons such as beam cannon!

description.ja: 中距離支援用のビーム・キャノン、４連マルチ・ランチャーは角度調整ができ、躍動感あるシーンを再現可能。
description.en: The beam cannon for medium-range support and the 4-bar multi-launcher can be adjusted in angle, allowing you to recreate dynamic scenes.

description.ja: ビーム・ライフルにはグレネード・ランチャー等の着脱可能な、新規造形の拡張装備が付属。
description.en: The beam rifle comes with newly designed expansion equipment that can be attached and removed, such as a grenade launcher.

description.ja: 脚部増加装甲とともに追加された３連装グレネード・ランチャーは開閉ギミックを搭載。
description.en: The triple grenade launcher added along with the increased leg armor has an opening/closing gimmick.

description.ja: 各追加武装は着脱が可能。
description.en: Each additional weapon can be attached and detached.

description.ja: ●　増加装甲など特徴的な本体形状を新規造形で再現！
description.en: ● Reproduce the characteristic body shape such as increased armor with new modeling!

description.ja: 胸部、肩部、腰部フロントアーマー、左腕、脚部の各増加装甲を新規造形で再現。
description.en: The additional armor on the chest, shoulders, waist front armor, left arm, and leg are reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: ●　水転写デカール付属！
description.en: ● Water transfer decal included!

description.ja: コーションマークなどを収録した新規デザインのマーキングが水転写デカールで付属。
description.en: Newly designed markings including caution marks etc. are included as water transfer decals.

description.ja: ●　パーツの差し替えで、一部増加装甲の取り外しやシールドの取り付けが可能。
description.en: ● By replacing parts, it is possible to remove some additional armor and install Seals.

description.ja: 付属武装 ： ビーム・キャノン ／ ４連マルチ・ランチャー ／ ビーム・ライフル ／ ビーム・サーベル ／
description.en: Attached weapons: Beam cannon / 4-barreled multi launcher / Beam rifle / Beam saber /

description.ja: バルカン・ポッド・システム ／ ハンド・グレネード ／ シールド
description.en: Vulcan Pod System / Hand Grenade / Seal
